Overview of Military and Protective Services Openings in Phoenix

A wide array of employment opportunities within the military, law enforcement, defense contracting, and protective services sectors have been listed across the Greater Phoenix, Arizona metropolitan area. The available positions span municipal agencies, federal departments, and private defense or security contractors operating in locations including Phoenix, Mesa, Scottsdale, Tempe, Surprise, Chandler, and Florence.

Confirmed Openings and Roles

The listings reflect diverse professional requirements, ranging from entry-level recruits to specialized technical and managerial positions. Confirmed roles include:

  • Law Enforcement: Police Officer Recruits and Lateral Officers for municipal departments including Mesa, Phoenix, Surprise, Avondale, Scottsdale, and Peoria. Additionally, Maricopa County and Pinal County have listed openings for Detention Deputies, Corrections-related roles, and Deputy Sheriff Cadets.
  • Federal and Defense Agencies: Positions such as Special Agent with the U.S. Secret Service (noting a recruitment incentive), Medical Care Transportation Technicians and Paralegals with the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, Human Resources Specialists with the Army National Guard, and Advanced Practice Providers with U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE).
  • Private Security and Defense Contracting: Armed and unarmed security officers, site supervisors, and transportation detention officers offered by companies such as GardaWorld Federal Services, Akima, Allied Universal, Inter-Con Security, and Securitas Critical Infrastructure Services. Technical and engineering roles, including Embedded Software Engineers, Program Managers, and Network Administrators, are also listed through firms like Viasat and General Dynamics Mission Systems.

User Impact and Practical Implications

For job seekers in Arizona—particularly veterans, former law enforcement personnel, and security professionals—the active regional market provides numerous entry points into public safety and defense support. Candidates must carefully review individual employer listings to match their background with specific prerequisites, such as prior aviation experience, active security clearances, or lateral law enforcement certifications.

What Is Confirmed Versus Unknown

  • Confirmed: A broad inventory of employers, job titles, and geographic locations within the Greater Phoenix area is documented via the source listing.
  • Unknown / Not Specified: For the vast majority of these listings, specific application deadlines, exact salary figures (with limited exceptions like an armed transportation officer role noting an hourly rate and certain sales positions), detailed selection processes, and step-by-step application instructions are not specified in the source text and must be verified directly through individual postings.

How to Verify and Apply

Readers interested in pursuing these opportunities should consult the original platform and individual organization portals to review complete job descriptions, verify active status, and submit applications. Further details can be checked directly via the [Official Source Link](https://in.linkedin.com/jobs/military-and-protective-services-jobs-phoenix-az).
